create_rearrange_task: create a RearrangeTask instance with a RearrangeSim simulator and dataset for object rearrangement episodes
reset_episode: reset the RearrangeTask with a new Episode to initialize robot positions and collision tracking
step_action: step the RearrangeTask with an action dictionary to execute robot movements and gripper actions
get_collision_forces: get collision forces for a robot by calling get_coll_forces with the robot_id index
duplicate_sensor_suite: duplicate robot-specific sensors across multiple robots by calling _duplicate_sensor_suite on the task
